overview_description.description:
Arist is a tool that helps enterprise L&D and HR teams rapidly create, deliver, and analyze message-based courses, which are bite-size learning experiences delivered in the flow of SMS, Slack, and MS Teams.

Along with saving over $200/employee/year with more efficient training, Arist helps companies create and track clear behavior change and performance improvement outcomes while delivering learning with an NPS of >90 and adoption rates that are 5x higher than traditional learning tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Arist helps companies deliver learning, training, and nudges in the flow of work via Teams, Slack, and text message-based courses.

product.name: Arist Platform
product.description: A learning and enablement platform for creating, delivering, and measuring microlearning, training, communications, and nudges through Slack, Microsoft Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, and other messaging channels.

product.name: Arist Creator (AI)
product.description: An AI course-authoring tool that converts company documents and other source materials into interactive, assessed, and translated training courses and communications.

product.name: Arist Auto
product.description: An automated learning-delivery capability that triggers personalized training and communications from events or data in existing business systems.

product.name: Arist for Frontline Teams
product.description: A frontline learning and communications solution that delivers training, compliance content, and nudges through SMS or WhatsApp without requiring a work device, laptop, or new app.
